title: Armenia prepares UNESCO nominations for ancient Artashat and Syunik rock-cut settlements
description: YEREVAN — Armenia is preparing new nominations for UNESCO’s World Heritage Tentative List, including the ancient capital of Artashat and historic rock-cut settlements in Syunik Province. Education, Science, Culture and Sport Minister Zhanna Andreasyan announced the plans on November 6 during parliamentary discussions on the draft 2027 state budget.
